judge.rationale: The candidate never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, meaning the bug remains unfixed and its newly added test in `src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrow.acceptance.test.ts` fails immediately. Furthermore, the candidate omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry specified in the acceptance criteria and left behind an internal `.lore/dod.md` scratch file. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate replaced the bullet under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (leaving the surrounding prose claiming 'These three properties... This issue changes none of them' contradictory) rather than moving the guarantee into the main specification section as the reference did. Finally, the candidate created a separate test file instead of adding the test case to the existing `beforeSession` describe block in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
